recipes.name: Spinach, Blueberry & "Feta" Salad
instructions: Add all the "feta" ingredients to a small food processor and blend until creamy. Transfer to an airtight container and store in the fridge for at least 3 hours to harden*.
For the dressing, combine the ingredients in a small bowl.
To assemble the salad, add the spinach, blueberries and shallot to a large bowl. Drizzle over some dressing and toss to coat.
Top with a crumbling of the feta and the chopped walnuts. Serve with extra dressing and feta on the side. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Refined coconut oil is coconut oil that doesn't smell or taste like coconuts. Using refined coconut oil is preferred to unrefined as the feta retains a more neutral flavour. * The longer it sits in the fridge, the more crumbly the texture will become.

Storage The undressed salad can be store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. The poppyseed dressing can be kept in a sealed glass jar for up to 4 days. The tofu feta can be kept in its container for up to 5 days.
